messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert PD12345 fired: HIGH - vGPU memory pressure detected on pool vgpu-west2a. 12% alloc failures in last 1m, 8 hosts reporting CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY. Affected model variants: gpt-neox-20B-q4, gpt-j-6B-q4.

alice_oncall: ACK - I'm on it. Pulling logs and isolating pool.

bob_sre: I can see repeated NVML errors on host gpu-13: 
```
[2026-03-17T14:02:03Z] nvml: gpu=13 pid=22456 cudaMalloc failed: out of memory
[2026-03-17T14:02:04Z] kvcache: eviction spike -> remining 4MB free
[2026-03-17T14:02:05Z] runtime: prefetch task failed, falling back to host memory
```

alice_oncall: Thanks. Starting proactive reroute: small/latency-sensitive requests -> cpu-fallback-route, and enable aggressive batching on remaining vGPU hosts to reduce allocation churn. Pushing route change now. :gear:

pd-bot: PagerDuty note: alert PD12345 acknowledged by alice_oncall at 2026-03-17T14:03:12Z. Escalation timer set to 10m.

carla_cust_eng: Any customer-visible issues yet? Two customers (acct-a, acct-b) just reported 5xx spikes and timeouts. CS alerted and opening INC-9876.

alice_oncall: Confirmed. Metrics: 5xx rate for gpt-neoX traffic rose from 0.2% -> 3.8% at 14:01. Latency P95 increased ~420ms for a short window. Impacted traffic primarily on dedicated vgpu-west2a pool. CS notified, ticket linked: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-9876

dino_dev: I'm kicking off a kvcache purge and reducing per-request prefetch by 30% on those hosts to free KV cache. Also rolling a small driver bump (cuda 12.2.1 -> 12.2.3) on one canary node to test reclaim behavior.

bob_sre: Rolling one host out of pool to trigger evacuation; host gpu-13 moved to cordoned. Telemetry shows immediate drop in alloc failures on that host but others spiked briefly.

alice_oncall: Reroute completed. CPU fallback handled ~18% of requests for 3m window. No errors on fallback path. Still seeing alloc failures on 3 hosts. PagerDuty escalation pending if not cleared in 8m.

pd-bot: PD escalation: alert PD12345 escalated to eng-runtime on timeout.

bob_sre: I'm taking over active mitigation. Action items I have: 1) continue draining problematic hosts, 2) run targeted nvml repro to reproduce leak, 3) coordinate with runtime team for kernel-level traces if repeat.

alice_oncall: Handing off: alice_oncall -> bob_sre. Summary: vGPU pool vgpu-west2a experiencing CUDA OOM spikes likely related to KV cache prefetch + driver edge-case. Reroute in place, CS notified (INC-9876), temporary mitigations applied (kvcache purge, prefetch throttling, one host driver canary). Escalated to eng-runtime. Please keep PD ticket updated. :arrow_right:

bob_sre: Taking it. I'll update within 10m with status and ETA. If we can't stabilize, we'll expand reroute and consider temporary capacity bump in another region.

alice_oncall: Thanks — marking handoff complete. If anything new, ping @bob_sre directly or reopen PD.

bob_sre: Noted. Creating follow-up runbook item and linking to incident ticket. Will schedule a short postmortem after stabilization.

incident-bot: Note: PD12345 status changed -> acknowledged -> escalated -> assigned to bob_sre.

alice_oncall: Closing my shift log here. Good job team. :thumbsup:

bob_sre: Continuing watch. Will post final resolution + root cause once confirmed.
